field.title: SPHEREx DR1 · field around van Maanen 2 (WD 0046+051)
field.centre_note: Field centre = approximate position of van Maanen 2 for 2025.8 (literature J2000 position 00 49 09.90 +05 23 19.0 and proper motion (+1.23, -2.71)"/yr propagated by hand), used only to centre the archive query and cutouts. SkyShift has not identified, matched or measured any source in these images; Gaia DR3 predictions need a recorded Gaia query for this field.
field.purpose: Stage-1 verification field for a candidate known moving source (white dwarf, proper motion ~3"/yr): a bounded DR1 SIA2 query on 2026-11-15 found 216 Spectral Images containing this position, in two observing seasons (2025-06/07 and 2025-12/2026-01), on all six detectors. Data acquisition and checks only: no target measurement is enabled.
